name: Football-Data.org
tagline: European football fixtures, results, and standings via a free-tier REST API
description: Football-Data.org provides REST access to European football competitions, match fixtures and results, team data, and league tables. Developers use a free API key with published request caps; higher tiers unlock more competitions and higher limits. Coverage focuses on major European leagues and UEFA competitions rather than global sports data.

auth.details: API key via X-Auth-Token header after self-serve registration on football-data.org

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free tier with request rate limits and limited competition access; exact 2026 caps confirmed on pricing/docs pages
pricing.paid_plans: Paid plans expand competitions and rate limits

rate_limits: Published on free vs paid tiers; confirm exact numbers from official pricing
use_cases: list today's fixtures for a competition
fetch match results for a team
look up competition schedule by season
